'''Lorcan Neeblo''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] criminal lived during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Neeblo was a member of the [[Intarsa League]], a criminal faction based on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Genarius]], and around [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], Neeblo accompanied the League on a [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] journey to the world [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] on a mission to set up a shell company as a front for the League's money laundering. However, the shuttle was ambushed en-route by rivals of the Intarsa League and the [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] crash-landed in the grounds of the [[Blue Star Centre]], a [[Philosopher/Legends|philosophical]] research facility. Neeblo survived the crash but his [[Lorcan Neeblo's best friend|best friend]] and [[Lorcan Neeblo's lover|lover]] were both [[Death/Legends|killed]] in the impact, leaving Neeblo distraught and determined to seek revenge.

In the aftermath of the crash, Neeblo and the surviving members of the Intarsa League entered the Blue Star Centre and took the facility's inhabitants hostage in an attempt to gain passage off of Cularin. However, the [[Heroes of Cularin]], a group of freelance agents who operated in and around the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]], [[Skirmish in the Blue Star Centre|attacked]] the Intarsa League and defeated Neeblo and the other crash survivors to free the hostages.
